meta.source: CityMETER Fitness Thailand — Research Master, tab 16_BRAND_LOGOS, and the research team's logo library (every file SHA-256 checked against the tab)
meta.identityRole: Identify the brand next to its name in pins, lists, charts and panels; the brand name stays the record of identity
meta.display: original bytes when display-sized (SVG, or raster ≤ 512 px and ≤ 64 KB); otherwise a uniform downscale to 384 px longest side (WebP); a large empty transparent margin is trimmed to the artwork + 6 % — no recolouring, ink cropping, tracing or upscaling
meta.backing: theme-invariant backing from the library's recommended surface: light #FFFFFF, dark #182327, mid-tone #7B877D; opaque files cover their own backing
